recipe.visualDefinition: A central, gritty portrait of a man in workwear covered in mud, framed by a thick, heavily textured leather-like border with a distinct drop shadow. The composition uses a warm, monochromatic brown palette and features contrasting typographic styles: a dynamic, multi-layered script and a stable, classical serif.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait is recessed within a textured frame using a hard drop shadow.
The top-left script typography overlaps both the frame and the internal image.
The bottom serif text is centered and anchored within the lower frame margin.
The monochromatic brown tones unify the disparate textures of denim, skin, mud, and leather.
coreInvariants: Heavily creased leather texture for the outer border.
Central subject looking downward to create a somber, focused mood.
Warm, earthy color grading across all elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait centered within an inner rectangular frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's mud-caked face and hands at the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left script logo, moves down to the subject's face, follows the downward gaze to the hands, and rests on the bottom title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick leather border acts as a massive frame, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre and Burnt Umber (leather and mud textures).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted Indigo (denim shirt providing a cool counterpoint).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream/Off-white (used for text highlights and highlights on skin).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast in texture; values are concentrated in the mid-to-dark range.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of heavy brush script and classical Roman serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Thick-to-thin transitions, 45-degree upward slant, heavy black drop shadow with a white inline.
Serif: High-contrast strokes, bracketed serifs, wide proportions.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters are tightly kerned and overlapping to form a singular graphic unit.
Serif text uses wide tracking for a cinematic feel.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Dynamic, slanted script for the brand name paired with a stable, wide serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Inner rectangular frame with internal drop shadow

preserve: The 'recessed' look of the central photo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bold, retro-script feel with high contrast.
Provides the classical, wide-serif look for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution texture of crumpled, brown leather. In the center, place a rectangular frame with a deep inner shadow. Inside the frame, place a photograph of a man with a beard, wearing a denim shirt, covered in mud, looking down at his hands. The entire image should have a warm, sepia-toned color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, slanted script logo in the top left corner with a thick black outline and white fill. At the bottom center, add a wide-spaced, all-caps serif title in white.

verificationChecks: Is the leather texture visible and tactile?
Does the script text overlap the frame edge?
Is the color palette strictly warm and earthy?

adjustableVariables: Amount of mud on the subject
The angle of the script slant
The width of the outer border
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the inner shadow makes the photo look recessed.
Ensure the script text has a distinct black outline.
Verify the bottom text is perfectly centered and legible.
Confirm the leather texture does not look like a flat pattern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central framed portrait + heavy textured border + slanted script top-left + wide serif bottom-center + monochromatic earth-tone grading.
